open_points.subject: answer_request request-bound measurement and canonicalization order
open_points.text: Each JSON text the message carries as a string is measured on its own by canonical_bytes, so the message around it adds no depth to it.
open_points.other_text: After every request bound is checked on the texts as received, as the last step of the fit check, before the actor check and before any handler runs, MUST replace every JSON text the request carries — the json_text of each RequestJsonValue and RequestConstant, the value_schema of every Port and RequestConstant, the guard_value of every EdgeGuard — by its canonical form obtained from canonical_bytes; a NonCanonicalValueError there is invalid_request, so modules below receive only canonical JSON (A01 rule 1). A text whose canonical form outgrows a bound it met as received is not refused here: the module that judges the value measures its canonical bytes, as start_run refuses a run input whose canonical bytes exceed the stored value ceiling.
open_points.question: Must JSON-text request bounds be measured using canonical_bytes, or from the UTF-8 text as received with canonical_bytes first applied only after all request bounds pass?
